dhavrAdh vazhaGghabhbhaDhDha yUdharghaLuM in2jIl vazhaGghabhbhaDhDha ghir2isdhavarghaLuM dhaGghaLin2 bhiLLaighaLai mar2r2avarghaLin2 bhiLLaighaLilirundhu bhiridhdhar2ivaidhaibh bhon2r2u muhaMmadhu nabhiyai muzhumaiyAgha ar2ivArghaL. avarghaL dhAn2 dhaGghaLaidh dhAGghaLe naraghadhdhil nuzhaidhdhu izhabhbhai er2bhaDhudhdhigh ghòNDhavarghaL. avarghaL naMbhighghai ghòLLamADhDhArghaL.

allAhvughghu iNaiyai er2bhaDhudhdhi avan2uDhan2 jherdhdhu vaNaGghiyavarai viDha alladhu allAh dhan2 dhUdhar mIdhu ir2aghghiya vajhan2aGghaLai nirAgharidhdhavarghaLai viDha mighabhbhèruM aniyAyaghghAran2 ver2u yArumillai. allAhvughghu iNaiyai er2bhaDhudhdhi avan2uDhaiya vajhan2aGghaLai mar2ughghuM aniyAyaghghArarghaL bhAvaman2n2ibhbhugh ghoravillaiyèn2il òrubhodhuM vèr2r2i bhèr2amADhDhArghaL.

ibhbharIDhjhaiyin2 bhin2 dhAM vaNaGghi vandha dhaGghaLin2 ghaDhavuLghaLiDhamirundhu vilaghigh ghòLvadhaidh dhavira avarghaLughghu ver2u èndha vazhiyuM irughghAdhu. “èGghaL ir2aivA! nAGghaL un2aghghu yAraiyuM iNaiyAghghavillai. mAr2Agha nAGghaL un2n2ai maDhDhume vijhuvAjhaM ghòNDhu vaNaGghigh ghòNDhirundhoM.” èn2a avarghaL bhòyyuraibhbhArghaL.

muhaMmadhe! dhAM iNai vaighghavillaiyèn2r2u avarghaL èvvAr2u dhaGghaL mIdhe bhòyyuraighghir2ArghaL èn2r2u bhAruM. ivvulagha vAzhvil avarghaL bhòyyAgha ir2aivan2oDhu bhun2aindha iNai dhèyvaGghaL avarghaLai viDhDhuM mar2aindhu, avarghaLaigh ghaiviDhDhuviDhDhan2a.

dhUdhare! nIr alghurAn2ai odhuMbhodhu iNai vaibhbhALarghaLil jhilar uM bhaghghaM ghAdhughòDhudhdhugh gheDhghir2ArghaL. Ayin2uM gheDhbhavai mUlaM avarghaL bhayan2aDhaivadhillai. avarghaLin2 bhiDhivAdhaM mar2r2uM bhur2aghghaNibhbhin2Al alghurAn2aibh bhurindhughòLLa muDhiyAdhavAr2u avarghaLin2 uLLaGghaLil dhiraiyai er2bhaDhudhdhiyuLLoM. avarghaLin2 ghAdhughaLil aDhaibhbhai er2bhaDhudhdhiyuLLoM. avarghaLAl bhayan2uLLa viSayaGghaLaijh jhèviyur2a muDhiyAdhu. èvvaLavu dhAn2 avarghaL dhèLivAn2a AdhAraGghaLaiyuM, jhAn2r2ughaLaiyuM ghaNDhAluM avarghaL naMbhighghaighòLLa mADhDhArghaL. èndhaLavughghèn2r2Al avarghaL uMmiDhaM ajhadhdhiyadhdhaigh ghòNDhu vAdhiDha varuMbhodhu, “mundhiya vedhaGghaLilirundhe nIr indha viSayaGghaLaiyèllAM ghòNDhu vandhIr” èn2r2u avarghaL ghUr2uvArghaL.

avarghaL dhUdhar mIdhu naMbhighghai ghòLvadhai viDhDhuM maghghaLaidh dhaDhughghir2ArghaL. dhAmuM adhilirundhu dhUramAghir2ArghaL. maghghaLaibh bhayan2aDhaiya viDhuvadhumillai. avarghaL adhilirundhu bhayan2aDhaivadhumillai. idhan2 mUlaM avarghaL dhaGghaLughghudh dhAGghaLe azhivai er2bhaDhudhdhigh ghòLghir2ArghaL. avarghaL jhèydhughòNDhirubhbhadhu dhaMmaidh dhAme azhighghuM velai èn2bhadhai avarghaL ar2indhughòLvadhillai.

dhUdhare! mar2umai nALil avarghaL nèrubhbhin2 mun2 nir2udhdhabhbhaDhDhu, “andho, allAhvin2 vajhan2aGghaLai mar2ughghAmal avan2ai naMbhighghai ghòNDhavarghaLAgha Aghuvadhar2ghu, nAGghaL mINDhuM ulagha vAzhghghaiyin2 bhAl dhirubhbhi an2ubhbhabhbhaDha mADhDhomA!” èn2a avarghaL ghaijhedhabhbhaDhDhu ghUr2uM bhodhu, avarghaLadhu avalanilai ghaNDhu nIr AjhjhariyabhbhaDhuvIr.

nIGghaL AjhaighòLLuM ivvulagha vAzhghghai allAhvaidh dhirubhdhiyaDhaijh jhèyyuM ghAriyaGghaLaijh jhèyyAdhavarghaLughghu viLaiyADhDhuM, emAr2r2amumeyAghuM. ir2ainaMbhighghai, vaNaghgha vazhibhADhu Aghiya allAhvin2 ghaDhDhaLaighaLaijh jhèyalbhaDhudhdhi, iNaivaibhbhu, bhAvaM Aghiya avan2 dhaDhudhdhuLLavar2r2ilirundhu vilaghi avan2ai aJjhaghghUDhiyavarghaLughghu mar2umaiyin2 vIDhu dhAn2 jhir2andhadhAghuM. iNaivaibhbhALarghaLe! nIGghaL idhan2aibh bhurindhughòNDhu avan2 mIdhu naMbhighghai ghòNDhu nar2jhèyal bhuriyamADhDhIrghaLA?

mINDhuM uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvadhai mar2ubhbhadhar2ghu avarghaL niyAyaGghaLaigh ghur2ibhbhiDhDhabhodhu allAh avarghaLughghubh bhadhilaLighghuM vidhamAgha bhin2varumAr2u ghUr2in2An2:
mINDhuM uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvadhai mar2ughghuM ivarghaL, bhiramANDhamAn2a vAn2aGghaLaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM bhaDhaidhdha allAh ivarghaLaibh bhon2r2avarghaLaibh bhaDhaibhbhadhar2ghu Ar2r2aluDhaiyavan2 èn2bhadhai ar2iyavillaiyA? mighabh bhèruM bhaDhaibhbhughaLaibh bhaDhaighgha jhaghdhibhèr2r2avan2, avar2r2ai viDha jhir2iya bhaDhaibhbhughaLaibh bhaDhaibhbhadhar2ghu jhaghdhiyuLLavan2e. allAh ivvulaghil avarghaLughghugh ghur2ibhbhiDhDha dhavaNaiyai er2bhaDhudhdhiyuLLAn2. adhdhavaNai vandhuviDhDhAl, avarghaLin2 vAzhghghai muDhivaDhaindhuviDhuM. avan2 avarghaLai mINDhuM uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhuvadhar2ghuM òru dhavaNaiyai er2bhaDhudhdhiyuLLAn2. adhil èdhdhaghaiya jhandheghamuM illai. mINDhuM èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvadhar2ghuriya dhèLivAn2a AdhAraGghaL irundhuM iNaivaibhbhALarghaL mar2ughghir2ArghaL.

iNai vaibhbhALarghaLin2 mar2ubhbhai nabhi(sal) avarghaL èdhirghòNDhabhodhu firavn2uDhan2uM, avan2adhu ghUDhDhadhdhuDhan2uM iDhaMbhèr2r2a mUsA (alai) avarghaLin2 jhaMbhavaGghaLin2 mUlaM nabhiyavarghaLughghu Ar2udhal ghiDhaidhdhuLLadhu. avan2 bhin2varumAr2u ghUr2ughir2An2:
"nAM mUsAvughghu avarughghAgha jhADhjhi ghUr2aghghUDhiya òn2bhadhu dhèLivAn2a jhAn2r2ughaLai vazhaGghin2oM. avai: ghaidhdhaDhi, ghai, bhaJjhaM, viLaijhjhalghaLil ghur2aibhADhu, vèLLaM, vèDhDhughghiLi, bhen2, dhavaLaighaL, iradhdhaM (èn2bhavaiyAghuM). dhUdhare! yUdharghaLiDhaM, avarghaLin2 mun2n2orghaLiDhaM mUsA ghòNDhuvandha ajhjhAn2r2ughaLaigh ghur2idhdhugh gheDhbhIrAgha. firavn2 avariDhaM: “mUsAve! nIr abhUrvamAn2a viSayaGghaLaigh ghòNDhu varuvadhan2Al nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 uMmai jhUn2iyaM jhèyyabhbhaDhDha man2idhar èn2r2u èNNughir2en2” èn2agh ghUr2in2An2.

"bhUmi adhiluLLavarghaLuDhan2 jherndhu ADhDhaM ghANAdhavAr2u uGghaLughghAgha adhan2ai ur2udhiyAn2adhAgha Aghghiyavan2 yAr? adhan2uLLe avan2 Ar2ughaLai oDhajhjhèydhAn2. ur2udhiyAn2a malaighaLaiyuM er2bhaDhudhdhin2An2. iru ghaDhalghaLughghiDhaiye avan2 òru dhiraiyai er2bhaDhudhdhin2An2. òn2r2in2 nIr ubhbhAghavuM, mar2r2òn2r2in2 nIr jhuvaiyAn2adhAghavuM irughghir2adhu. òn2r2oDhòn2r2u ghalandhu ghèDhDhuviDhAmal òru dhaDhubhbhai er2bhaDhudhdhiyuLLAn2. allAhvuDhan2 jherndhu idhan2aijh jhèyyuM ver2u edhAvadhu dhèyvaM uNDhA? illai. avarghaLil bhèruMbhAlAn2or ar2iyamADhDhArghaL. avarghaL ar2indhirundhAl, allAhvughghu èndhòru bhaDhaibhbhin2adhdhaiyuM iNaiyAghghiyirughghamADhDhArghaL".

"dhun2bhadhdhir2ghuLLAn2avan2 dhan2 dhun2bhadhdhai aghar2r2umAr2u bhirArdhdhighghuMbhodhu, avan2uDhaiya bhirArdhdhan2aighghubh bhadhilaLibhbhavan2 yAr? var2umai, noy mar2r2uM man2idhan2ughghu er2bhaDhuM en2aiya jhodhan2aighaLai nIghghaghghUDhiyavan2 yAr? bhUmiyil uGghaLai bharaMbharai bharaMbharaiyAgha bhiradhinidhiyAgha Aghghiyavan2 yAr? allAhvuDhan2 jherndhu idhan2aijh jhèyyuM ver2u edhAvadhu dhèyvaM uNDhA? illai. mAr2Agha nIGghaL mighagh ghur2aivAghave bhaDhibhbhin2ai bhèr2ughir2IrghaL, ubhadhejhaM bhèr2ughir2IrghaL".

"dharai mar2r2uM ghaDhal Aghiyavar2r2in2 iruLghaLil uGghaLughghAgha er2bhaDhudhdhiya naDhjhadhdhiraGghaL, aDhaiyALaGghaL mUlaM uGghaLughghu vazhighADhDhubhavan2 yAr? dhan2adhu aDhiyArghaLughghu gharuNaiyAn2a mazhai aNmaiyil bhòzhiya irubhbhadhAgha nar2jhèydhi ghUr2uM ghAr2r2ai an2ubhbhuvan2 yAr? allAhvuDhan2 jherndhu idhan2aijh jhèyyuM ver2u edhAvadhu dhèyvaM uNDhA? dhan2adhu bhaDhaibhbhin2aGghaLil avarghaL avan2ughghu iNaiyAghghubhavar2r2ai viDhDhuM allAh dhUymaiyAn2avan2".

"gharuvar2aighaLil ghaDhDhaM ghaDhDhamAghabh bhaDhaighgha AraMbhidhdhu, bhin2n2ar adhan2ai maraNighghajhjhèydhu, mINDhuM uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhubhavan2 yAr? dhan2 bhur2adhdhilirundhu ir2aghghabhbhaDhuM mazhai mUlaM vAn2ilirundhuM, dhAvaraGghaLai muLaighghajh jhèyvadhan2 mUlamuM, bhUmiyilirundhuM uGghaLughghu vAzhvAdhAraM aLibhbhavan2 yAr? allAhvuDhan2 jherndhu idhan2aijh jhèyyuM ver2u edhAvadhu dhèyvaM uNDhA? dhUdhare! nIr indha iNai vaibhbhALarghaLiDhaM “nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL dhAM jhadhdhiyadhdhil irughghin2r2oM èn2r2u nIGghaL ghUr2uM vAdhadhdhil nIGghaL uNmaiyALarghaLAgha irundhAl, nIGghaL jhèydhu ghòNDhirughghuM iNai vaibhbhughghu AdhAradhdhaigh ghòNDhu vAruGghaL” èn2agh ghUr2uvIrAgha.

dhUdhare! “vAn2aGghaLil irughghuM vAn2avarghaLo, bhUmiyil irughghuM man2idharghaLo mar2aivAn2avar2r2ai ar2iya mADhDhArghaL. allAh òruvan2e adhan2ai ar2ivAn2. avarghaL ghUli ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvadhar2ghAgha èbhbhodhu èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvArghaL èn2bhadhai allAhvaidh dhavira, vAn2aGghaLiluM bhUmiyiluM uLLa èvaruM ar2iyamADhDhArghaL" èn2r2u nIr ghUr2uvIrAgha.

avarghaL mar2umai bhar2r2i dhòDharAghadh dhèrindhu, adhan2ai ur2udhiyAgha naMbhiviDhDhArghaLA? illai, avarghaL mar2umaiyaigh ghur2idhdhu jhandheghadhdhiluM, dhaDhumAr2r2adhdhiluM irughghir2ArghaL. èn2in2uM, avarghaLin2 bhArvaighaL adhan2aibh bhurindhughòLvadhai viDhDhuM ghuruDhAghiviDhDhan2a.
nirAgharibhbhALarghaL mar2ubhbhudh dhèrividhdhavarghaLAgha “nAGghaL ir2andhu maNNoDhu maNNAghiviDhDhAluM mINDhuM uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvomA?" èn2agh gheDhghin2r2an2ar.

"idhar2ghu mun2n2ar nAGghaLuM, èGghaL mun2n2orghaLuM mINDhuM èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvoM èn2r2u vAghghaLighghabhbhaDhDhoM. An2Al andha vAghghur2udhi nighazhvadhai nAM ghANavillai. èGghaL an2aivarughghuM aLighghabhbhaDhDha indha vAghghur2udhi mun2n2orghaL dhaGghaLin2 bhudhdhaghaGghaLil èzhudhi vaidhdhuLLa avarghaLin2 ghaDhDhugh ghadhaighaLeyAghuM".

dhUdhare! mar2umai nALai mar2ughghuM indha nirAgharibhbhALarghaLiDhaM “bhUmiyil naDhamADhighghòNDhu mar2umai nALaibh bhòybhbhidhdha ghur2r2avALighaLin2 ir2udhi muDhivu èn2n2avAyir2r2u èn2bhadhai jhindhidhdhubh bhAruGghaL. adhan2ai avarghaL mar2udhdhadhAl nAM avarghaLai azhidhdhuviDhDhoM" èn2agh ghUr2uvIrAgha.

uMmuDhaiya azhaibhbhai iNai vaibhbhALarghaL bhur2aghghaNighghuM ghAraNadhdhAl, nIr ghavalai ghòLLAdhIr. avarghaL umaghghu èdhirAghajh jhèyyuM jhUzhjhjhighaLAl umadhu nèJjhaM nèrughghaDhighghuLLAghi viDhaveNDhAM. nijhjhayamAgha allAh avarghaLughghu èdhirAgha umaghghu udhavi jhèyvAn2.

uM jhamUghadhdhil mar2umai nALai mar2ughghuM nirAgharibhbhALarghaL “dhaNDhan2ai ir2aGghuM èn2r2a uGghaLadhu ghUr2r2il nIGghaL uNmaiyALarghaLAgha irundhAl, nIruM naMbhighghaiyALarghaLuM èGghaLughghu èjhjharidhdha avvedhan2ai èbhbhodhu nighazhuM?” èn2agh gheDhghin2r2an2ar.
dhUdhare! nIr avarghaLiDhaM “nIGghaL avajharamAgha veNDhiya vedhan2aiyin2 jhila bhaghudhighaL uGghaLai nèruGghiyarughghagh ghUDhuM” èn2r2u ghUr2uvIrAgha.

dhUdhare! nijhjhayamAgha uM ir2aivan2 man2idharghaLin2 mIdhu bheraruL bhuribhavan2. adhan2Al dhAn2 avan2 avarghaL nirAgharibhbhiluM bhAvaGghaLiluM mUzhghiyirundhuM, avarghaLai uDhan2ughghuDhan2 dhaNDhighghAmal viDhDhuviDhughir2An2. Ayin2uM man2idharghaLil bhèruMbhAlAn2or allAh dhaGghaLughghu aLidhdha aruDhghòDhaighaLughghu nan2r2i jhèludhdhuvadhillai.

umadhu èllA vivaghAraGghaLiluM allAhvaiye jhArndhirubhbhIrAgha. nijhjhayamAgha nIr dhèLivAn2a jhadhdhiyadhdhil irughghin2r2Ir.

jhadhdhiyadhdhai viDhDhuM bhArvaighaL ghuruDhAn2avarghaLughghu uMmAl vazhighADhDha muDhiyAdhu. avarghaLughghAghagh ghavalaibhbhaDhDhu uMmai nIre varudhdhigh ghòLLAdhIr. naMmuDhaiya vajhan2aGghaLai naMbhuvorughghe jhadhdhiyadhdhaibh bhuriyajh jhèyyamuDhiyuM. en2èn2il avarghaL allAhvin2 evalughghugh ghaDhDhubhbhaDhDhavarghaL.

mar2umaiyil mINDhuM uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhabhbhaDhuvadhai mar2ubhbhavarghaL nijhjhayamAgha dhUghghadhdhin2 mUlaM avarghaL oyvèDhubhbhadhar2ghAgha iravaiyuM, dhaGghaLin2 bhaNighaLil IDhubhaDhuvadhar2ghAgha bhiraghAjhamAn2a bhaghalaiyuM nAM er2bhaDhudhdhiyuLLoM èn2bhadhaibh bhArghghavillaiyA? nijhjhayamAgha dhiruMbhadh dhiruMbha iDhaMbhèr2uM indha maraNadhdhiluM, adhan2bhin2 uyirghòDhudhdhu èzhubhbhudhaliluM naMbhighghai ghòLLuM maghghaLughghu dhèLivAn2a AdhAraGghaL irughghin2r2an2a.
